source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 320 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 320 was established by Ordinance No. 20434, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 13, 1989. Ordinance No. 20434 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 320 is established on property generally located at the south corner of Martin Luther King, Jr. Boulevard and Meyers Street. The size of PD 320 is approximately 12.16 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and provisions contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 320A). (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.105. USES.

The following uses are the only main uses permitted on the Property:

(1) Community service center.

(2) Library, art gallery, or museum.

(3) Child-care facility.

(4) Medical clinic or ambulatory surgical center.

(5) Public park, playground, or golf course. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.106. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

Floor area on the Property is limited to 158,900 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.107. LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum permitted lot coverage is 45 percent. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.108. HEIGHT.

(a) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. (See Section 51A-4.412.) Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less.

(b) Maximum height. Unless further restricted under Subsection (a), maximum height for any structure on the Property is 36 feet. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.109. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking on the Property must be provided in accordance with the development plan. The proposed parking, as shown on the development plan, must be completed prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any new development. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.110. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. All landscaping must be installed prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any new development on the Property. All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.111. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII, “Sign Regulations.” (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.112. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.113. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this

PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-320.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 320 is located on Zoning Map No. K-8. (Ord. Nos. 20434; 25850)
